title: A collapsed tool group rendered live partial output, shifting the pinned transcript
signal: selfRework pair: fix d7be986f on the same file 68 minutes after 0f7f3dd9

missed.summary: The group renderer showed a preview row whenever a partial result existed. Bash reports an empty partial result as it starts, so each running call added a blank row and removed it on completion, moving the bottom-pinned transcript twice per turn. The follow-up fix removed live output from collapsed groups entirely rather than filtering empty text.

fix.change: Reviewers must state what a collapsed or grouped row renders while a tool is still running, not only after it settles.
